info.title: OfficePulse Integration API
info.description: Native Asterisk inventory and opt-in POC provisioning, integration call diagnostics and signed callbacks. Asterisk remains the PBX source of truth; provisioning writes its Realtime tables directly and keeps no desired-state copy. These docs are publicly readable; administrative requests remain restricted to trusted backends.

post.description: Bootstrap v2. Requires native admission enabled. Verifies the intended dispatch and SIP identity/SID with LiveKit, re-derives route ownership for the pinned routing scope {pbxInstanceId, context} from Asterisk, checks the current profile assignment, and atomically consumes both credentials. The snapshot scope must equal the dispatch metadata scope. Always no-store; never retry an ambiguous response.

parameters.name: Authorization
parameters.description: Bearer bootstrapToken from dispatch metadata. Not a staff credential.

pbxInstanceId.description: Serving PBX instance; with context it is the routing scope and must equal the dispatch metadata.

context.description: Extension context owning the routed queue.

tenantId.description: Optional customer identity for authorization/observation; never a routing key.

version.description: Pacific (America/Los_Angeles, PST/PDT) commit timestamp (YYYY.M.D.H.M); -dirty for uncommitted changes; unbuilt in source development mode

sourceUpdatedAt.description: Commit time with Pacific UTC offset

get.description: HTTP 200 means critical dependencies are ready. Inspect components.pbx-inventory separately. fullyOperational stays false when voice/native admission is unavailable. pbxInstanceId names the serving PBX instance so clients can pin the routing scope they administer.

get.summary: List the Asterisk contexts present on this PBX instance
get.description: Private admitted backend network or Identity-authenticated Operations gateway (Super Admin). Distinct contexts from native endpoint and dialplan rows, without a context parameter. Feeds the AidaAdmin tenant form and the Operations context selector; listing a context grants nothing.

403.description: Caller not admitted or not authorized

503.description: Database, schema or inventory unavailable, or more than 1000 contexts

get.summary: List native extensions of one context with managed-route detection
get.description: Private admitted backend network or Identity-authenticated Operations gateway (Super Admin) with mutation CSRF. Ownership is derived from Asterisk records inside the requested context of this PBX instance. PBX mutations and DID reads require PBX_PROVISIONING_ENABLED=true plus dedicated writer credentials. Disabled mutation routes are absent. Credentials are returned only by extension creation; responses must not be cached.

parameters.description: Exactly one Asterisk extension context on this PBX instance; duplicate values and the retired iTenantId parameter are rejected. A context name selects the scope and is never authorization by itself.

get.summary: Read managed routes owned by this context; identify foreign, manual and unconfigured Identity Numbers explicitly
get.description: Private admitted backend network. AidaAdmin revalidates Identity tenant access, resolves the tenant's extension and DID ingress contexts, and supplies the current tenant Number assignments. DID routes are excluded from the browser Operations gateway. PBX mutations and DID reads require PBX_PROVISIONING_ENABLED=true plus dedicated writer credentials.

parameters.name: context
parameters.description: Exactly one Asterisk extension context on this PBX instance; duplicate values and the retired iTenantId parameter are rejected. A context name selects the scope and is never authorization by itself.

parameters.name: didContext
parameters.description: Exactly one carrier ingress context holding the managed DID routes; it must differ from context.

parameters.name: authorizedDid
parameters.description: Repeatable globally unique E.164 Number freshly authorized for the requesting tenant by Identity through the trusted AidaAdmin backend.

post.description: Restricted to trusted application backends. A browser session, API key or bearer token does not bypass the network admission policy. AidaAdmin and the operations UI authenticate their human users separately. Requires VOICE_ENABLED=true. DRAIN_ACK is supported; TAKEOVER returns 503 until native destination admission exists. Dev returns voice_unavailable before executing commands.
Preserve the original request bytes and LiveKit Authorization header. Signature verification authenticates this callback when voice is enabled. With voice disabled, returns 503.
